title: Control action
description: Requests that create or control a run, their responses, and the record of a control action against an existing run. The root schema is that record.

action_kind.description: Control actions against an existing run. pause and resume are deferred: always refused with `unsupported` in this API version.

action_record.description: One control action against a run, as recorded in the run's event log and returned by an accepting route.

outcome.description: accepted: delivered to the run's worker. It does not promise any effect on the harness's behaviour. refused: not delivered; `error` says why.

submit_request.description: Body of POST /v1/runs. Optional fields are omitted, never null. Setting `session_id` asks for `continue_session` and setting `parent_run_id` asks for `delegate`; both are refused with `unsupported` in this API version. An `agent_id` whose node is not the core's node asks for `placement`, which is refused with `unsupported` until part two builds it (planned). No field of this request sets the run's `submitter` or `base_commit`.

deadline.description: Absolute UTC time by which the run must be terminal; must be later than the core's clock at submit.

submit_response.description: Response of POST /v1/runs. For a new run it is in state `queued` and its worker's PID, event log and cursor are on disk. When `replayed` is true the idempotency key matched an earlier submit: nothing was created and `run` is that first run as it is now.

replayed.description: True when the request repeated an earlier submit with the same idempotency key. Omitted otherwise.

warnings.description: Things the caller should know about a run that was admitted all the same. Omitted when there are none.

warning.description: One warning on an admitted submit.

code.description: signal_unknown: an admission signal could not be read or was stale, and a local submit was admitted without it.

steer_request.description: Body of POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/steer: a mid-run instruction delivered to the harness as user input.

pause_request.description: Body of POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/pause (deferred; always refused with `unsupported`, capability `pause`).

resume_request.description: Body of POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/resume (deferred; always refused with `unsupported`, capability `resume`).

answer_request.description: Body of POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/answer: the answer to one pending question of the run. For a `question`, give `answer`, `choice_ids` or both. For an `approval`, give `decision`; `answer` is then an optional reason the harness shows the model. The core checks the answer against the question (README: operator questions).

decision.description: The answer to an approval: whether the waiting action may run.

choice_ids.description: Choices picked from the question's `choices`, by id.

accepted_response.description: 202 response of steer, cancel and answer: the recorded, accepted action. When `replayed` is true the idempotency key matched an earlier request against this run: nothing was delivered again and `action` is the first one.

replayed.description: True when the request repeated an earlier one with the same idempotency key. Omitted otherwise.
